Team leaders Auburn Passing: Byrum Brown, 259 yards, 0 TDs, 3 INTs, 74.3 completion percentage Rushing: Jeremiah Cobb, 53 yards on 12 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Keshaun Singleton, 89 yards on 7 catches, 0 TDs Southern Miss Passing: Ethan Hampton, 180 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT, 56.5 completion percentage Rushing: Steven Robinson, 123 yards on 23 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Mario Sanders II, 94 yards on 6 catches, 1 TD Last game Auburn won 17-16 over Baylor on Sept. 5. Brown led Auburn with 259 yards on 26-of-35 passing (74.3%) for no touchdowns and three interceptions. He also carried the ball 21 times for 27 yards and one rushing touchdown. Cobb carried the ball 12 times for 53 yards and scored one touchdown, adding two receptions for eight yards. Singleton had seven receptions for 89 yards. Southern Miss defeated Alcorn State 49-3 on Sept. 5. Hampton passed for 180 yards on 13-of-23 attempts (56.5%) with one touchdown and one interception. Robinson had 123 rushing yards on 23 carries and three touchdowns. Sanders had six receptions for 94 yards and one touchdown. Next game Auburn hosts Florida on Sept. 19. Southern Miss hosts UConn on Sept. 19.
